title: Split CPT manager and CPT admin surfaces
description: Refactor includes/CPT/CptManager.php and includes/Admin/CptManagerAdmin.php into bounded CPT definition, field, taxonomy, admin form, and save modules.
objective: Keep custom post type management maintainable before adding more dynamic tag or field-source behavior.
acceptance_criteria: No CPT slug, taxonomy slug, option key, or registered meta key changes.
Nonce, capability, escaping, and sanitization checks remain equivalent.
Each CPT module stays below the plugin line budget.
verification: Dynamic tag field catalog smoke check passes if touched.
php scripts/verify-line-budget.php --strict passes or reports only tracked transition debt.

budgets.context_budget: CPT manager, admin CPT form, field catalog

risks: CPT registration order can change if extracted carelessly.
Meta sanitization and show_in_rest behavior can drift.
Admin form field names can break saved definitions.
